worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.summary: Latch roots onto a foe at close range: restore health scaled by how much stronger its Attack is than yours and drop its Attack by one stage. It saps strength, not life; no damage.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.descriptio: The roots reach a foe within %1$s blocks, which is also the real range.
The draw deals no damage; it restores about %1$s of your own maximum health, scaled by the target's Attack against your own - a stronger foe gives more, up to the health you are missing.

On hit the target's Attack actually drops by %1$s stage(s) under its ability policy: only a real drop carries the Sapped break mark for %2$s. If an ability prevents or reverses it, the real change is shown instead of a false weakening. While a companion is healthy it will not re-apply Strength Sap to a target it already drained. The Attack drop is a stat stage: it does not recover when the mark expires, but lasts until the target leaves combat or its stat stages are reset.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.deep.on: Deep draw: x1.35 healing and x1.2 break duration, at +0.1 s wind-up, a shorter reach (x0.9) and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.deep.off: Light draw: longer reach, faster wind-up and cooldown, with slightly less healing and a shorter break, for sustained attrition.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.growth.1: From level %1$s the drain share rises to %2$s, the Attack loss to %3$s and the opening to %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.use.0: Take a big mouthful of health from a strong foe when low
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.use.1: Pin a physical attacker's Attack on the way through
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.use.2: Shave a layer of strength off a physical threat first
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.preference: On: x1.35 healing and x1.2 break duration, but +0.1 s wind-up, a shorter reach (x0.9) and x1.15 cooldown, for one big gulp. Off: a lighter draw with longer reach, faster wind-up and cooldown.
Only reach out when a threat is this close; larger goes further to latch on.
Below this health ratio the user prefers strength sap as sustain; higher spends it sooner.
A target whose current effective Attack reaches this is treated as a strong foe and drained first; lower acts on ordinary foes, higher focuses on true high-Attack targets.
On: also leave a hold position to latch on.
